notes.title: Albert's Journey – Chat with Developers
notes.notes:
We know we can not compete with AAA titles. [i]Actually we do not.[/i] We know that Albert's Journey is quite simple. [i]But we also know,[/i] it is just a start. Probably you wondering why you could be interest in this title?
The answer is really easy. Two people with passion, involvement, determination and love with gaming are developing their own title. We pass the long way to this point and we are really happy that we can show you our results.
If you ever wonder what is all about Albert's Journey, fill free to join us to see how two people are developing their own game. Come meet Albert. Small creature with uncommon mind.
We will wait for you od Discord. [url=https://discord.gg/PjpMYP]LINK>>[/url]
